live_error_mitigation.verdict: REAL error mitigation on a fusion quantum circuit: ZNE cuts the noisy-energy error 44.38 -> 5.029 mHa (89% of the error removed) and inverse-confusion readout correction cuts the measurement TV distance 0.1472 -> 0.0 (100%). Mitigation is the REAL NISQ tool today — it recovers signal from noise. HONEST: it is NOT a speedup; quantum's meaningful role in fusion is post-~2036, and mitigation cost grows with noise. Runs on real hardware with KODEX_QC_BACKEND=ibm.

caveats: no quantum advantage — quantum's role in fusion is post-~2036
ZNE assumes a smooth noise->observable relation; it extrapolates, it does not eliminate noise, and its overhead grows as noise grows
readout mitigation uses a known confusion matrix; on hardware you must calibrate it
